items.title: EveningGlow
items.title_display: EveningGlow
items.summary: ざっくり編みの大きめカーディガンに、身体の線を出すノースリーブを合わせたギャップのある装い。厚みのある素材感で肌寒い季節の空気を纏える。
items.summary_en: A look full of contrast, pairing a large chunky-knit cardigan with a sleeveless top that shows the body line. The thick fabric texture captures the air of a chilly season.

items.title: 【18アバター対応】Mocha mode -モカ・モード-
items.title_display: 【18アバター対応】Mocha mode -モカ・モード-

items.summary_en: Calm grown-up casual pulled together around a mocha tone. The muted color scheme holds together well, fitting right into autumn world strolls.

items.title: Shawl【VRChat】
items.title_display: Shawl【VRChat】
items.summary: 肩に掛けるだけで一段よそゆきになる、季節を選ばない薄手のショール。ポリゴンが極端に軽くカラーも十種以上あり、手持ちの衣装に足しやすい。
items.summary_en: A thin season-agnostic shawl that makes any look a notch more dressed-up just by draping it over the shoulders. Extremely light in polygons with more than ten colors, it is easy to add to outfits you already own.

items.title: Mon Fleur Femme
items.title_display: Mon Fleur Femme

items.summary_en: An outfit that seems invited by the autumn wind, pairing a houndstooth jacket with lace tights. More than nine check variations and recolorable bags let you shift the seasonal mood while keeping the same shape.

items.title: Urban Waltz Street
items.title_display: Urban Waltz Street
items.summary: 肩から段になって落ちるフリル襟を、太いベルトで一気に締め上げたニットワンピース。編み地の陰影と脚のベルトで、静かな色気が立ち上がる。
items.summary_en: A knit one-piece where a tiered frill collar falling from the shoulders is cinched all at once by a wide belt. The shading of the weave and the leg belts bring up a quiet allure.

items.summary: 刺繍を入れた大きな襟のブラウスに、裾フリルの効いた深いえんじのフレアスカート。胸元の紅葉飾りが季節感を添え、歩くたび裾がふわりと揺れる。
items.summary_en: A large-collared embroidered blouse with a deep burgundy flared skirt trimmed in frills. Autumn-leaf ornaments at the chest add seasonality, and the hem sways softly with every step.

items.title: 【10 avatars】【VRC Hair】♥ Ivy_Hair ♥
items.title_display: 【10 avatars】【VRC Hair】 Ivy_Hair
items.summary: 毛先が外へ軽く跳ねた、ふんわり毛束感のあるショートボブ。横に流れる前髪が抜け感を作り小顔に見せてくれる、改変用テクスチャ付きで色変えも楽しめる愛らしい定番ヘア。
items.summary_en: A short bob with soft, airy volume and tips flicking lightly outward. Side-swept bangs create an airy feel and a small-face effect. An adorable classic that comes with a customization texture for recoloring.

items.title: ✦｡𖤐Asmodeus｡✦
items.title_display: Asmodeus
items.summary: 腰下まで流れる艶やかなスーパーロングに、鋭い角とコウモリ翼を添えた退廃的なヘアセット。ロングとショートが別Prefabで分かれ、印象を丸ごと切り替えられる。
items.summary_en: A decadent hair set with glossy super-long hair flowing past the waist, accented by sharp horns and bat wings. Long and short versions come as separate prefabs, letting you switch the whole impression.

items.title: Classic Sailor Vol.1 [PB]
items.title_display: Classic Sailor Vol.1 [PB]
items.summary: 黒のリブ地に金ボタンを効かせたクラシカルなセーラーワンピース。裾のフリルが歩くたび揺れ、無料で気軽に試せる一着。
items.summary_en: A classical sailor one-piece with gold buttons set against black ribbed fabric. The hem frill sways as you walk, and it is free so anyone can try it easily.

items.title: 2024年第9弾『BISQUE DOLL - ビスクドール - 』ギミック付きドール衣装
items.title_display: 2024年第9弾『BISQUE DOLL - ビスクドール - 』ギミック付きドール衣装
items.summary: 大ぶりの袖とフリルで人形めいた均衡を写したビスクドール衣装。背中のゼンマイや持ち運べるドールケースまで付き、飾って眺める楽しみもある。
items.summary_en: A bisque doll outfit that captures a doll-like balance with large sleeves and frills. A wind-up key on the back and a carryable doll case are included, so displaying it is a joy too.

items.title: 猫ロングヘア
items.title_display: 猫ロングヘア
items.summary: 毛先まで真っ直ぐ落ちるサラサラの超ロングに、厚めのぱっつん前髪を合わせた清楚なヘア。X字ピンや小花の髪飾りが顔まわりを可憐に彩る。175種のシェイプキーで毛流れや量感を細かく調整できる。
items.summary_en: A demure style pairing silky super-long straight hair flowing to the tips with thick blunt bangs. X-shaped pins and small floral accents prettily adorn the face. Finely adjust hair flow and volume with 175 shape keys.

items.title: ⚙️Steel Snowflake『SSF』❄️ #Libero_Boutique
items.title_display: Steel Snowflake『SSF』 #Libero_Boutique
items.summary: 発光ラインの走る装甲パーツと結晶状の翼を組み合わせた近未来コーデ。ウィングやヘイローは自由に付け外しでき、色替えで機体の印象ごと変わる。
items.summary_en: A near-future coordinate combining armor parts traced with glowing lines and crystalline wings. Wings and halo can be freely attached or removed, and recoloring changes the whole machine's impression.

items.title: 【キプフェル専用】 ♡ 𝐆𝐚𝐫𝐧𝐞𝐭 ♡ 【VRChat向け衣装+ヘアモデル】
items.title_en: [Kipfel Exclusive] Garnet [Outfit + Hair Model for VRChat]

items.title_en_display: [Kipfel Exclusive] Garnet [Outfit + Hair Model for VRChat]
items.summary: ハート型のトグルが並ぶざっくりカーディガンとセーラー襟のワンピース。合わせやすいツインテールのヘアモデルも同梱され、衣装だけの単品購入もできる。
items.summary_en: A chunky cardigan lined with heart-shaped toggles paired with a sailor-collar one-piece. An easy-to-match twintail hair model is bundled, and the outfit can also be bought on its own.

items.title: ♥6アバター対応♥Lovely pearl♥
items.title_display: 6アバター対応 Lovely pearl

items.summary_en: A cool off-shoulder look that bares the shoulders cleanly. The pearls gleam with refinement, making this free release just right for outings in the hot season.

items.title: 【12 avatars】【VRC Hair】♥ Lino_Hair ♥
items.title_display: 【12 avatars】【VRC Hair】 Lino_Hair
items.summary: サイドのお団子から毛先をゆるく巻いて垂らしたツインテール。リボンと髪飾りを添えた甘い作りで、ハーフアップの抜け感とふわふわの質感が映えるヘア。
items.summary_en: Twintails draped from side buns with tips loosely curled. A sweet design accented with ribbons and floral ornaments, showing off the airy feel of a half-up and a fluffy texture.

items.title: MellowRibbon【Renewal】
items.title_display: MellowRibbon【Renewal】
items.summary: 光沢のあるサテンが長く垂れる大ぶりのリボン。ブレンドシェイプで垂れの長さと向きを変えられ、白黒に淡い青とピンクを添えた四色入り。
items.summary_en: A large ribbon with long, glossy satin tails. Blendshapes change the length and direction of the drape, and four colors are included—black and white plus soft blue and pink.

items.title: 💛Layered Look💛 #LysAtelier
items.title_display: Layered Look #LysAtelier

items.summary_en: An autumn-winter layering set bundling a feminine version, a knit over a tiered ruffle dress, with a knit-focused masculine version. The knit comes in eight designs and colors, and removing it makes the outfit year-round.

items.title: 💉Medical Melty Nightmare💉
items.title_display: Medical Melty Nightmare
items.summary: 天使になりきれなかった看護師をテーマにした、甘く不穏なナースコーデ。巨大な注射器や輸血パックを提げ、輪と翼が背徳的な物語性を添える。
items.summary_en: A sweet-but-unsettling nurse look themed around an angel who couldn't quite become one. Carries an oversized syringe and blood bag, with a halo and wings adding a sinister note.

items.title: 【まめふれんず対応衣装】White Noise -ホワイトノイズ-
items.title_display: 【まめふれんず対応衣装】White Noise -ホワイトノイズ-

items.summary_en: A futuristic tactical techwear look unified in black-and-white monotone. Goggles and gloves balance ruggedness with cuteness.

items.title: 【Mellow Ribbon Hair】SIf_Emission【8Color+】
items.title_display: 【Mellow Ribbon Hair】SIf_Emission【8Color+】

items.summary_en: A hair-exclusive emission material where light streams down toward the tips. In AudioLink-compatible worlds it pulses with the bass, and elsewhere the flowing effect continues at fixed intervals.

items.title: ✡️Stella Space ✡️【3Dヘアモデル】【VRchat】
items.title_display: Stella Space 【3Dヘアモデル】【VRchat】

items.summary_en: A wolf-style short cut with heavy bangs covering the eyes and an eye-catching inner color at the tips. The brown-and-black contrast creates a mysterious mood, and the length and back-hair adjustment shape keys make it easy to handle.

items.title: けだものぐるみ!!【みみのこ対応】
items.title_display: けだものぐるみ!!【みみのこ対応】

items.summary_en: A cute-loose outfit starring a bunny beast popping out of a jersey long tee. Playful swaying eyes deliver a soothing charm.

items.title: 【MA対応】伸び～るバスピスマスコット
items.title_display: 【MA対応】伸び～るバスピスマスコット

items.summary_en: A Sacabambaspis mascot to wear on the head. Grab and pull the tail to stretch it and change its expression for a playful touch, with a mikan-topped kagami-mochi variant perfect for New Year photos.

items.title: PumpkinDrop【ハロウィン向け衣装】
items.title_display: PumpkinDrop【ハロウィン向け衣装】

items.summary_en: A Halloween outfit decorated with dripping patterns and pumpkin props. A playful yami-kawaii look accented with spiderwebs and bandages.

items.title: 【MA設定済み】G88レーザーライフル
items.title_display: 【MA設定済み】G88レーザーライフル

items.summary_en: A bolt-action laser rifle you can fire with hand signs. After firing you can eject the shell just by touching it, and it can be operated from either hand.

items.title: 夏風残響～風鈴型ピアス＆簪～
items.title_display: 夏風残響～風鈴型ピアス＆簪

items.title: しなの対応衣装【Tech Wear】
items.title_display: しなの対応衣装【Tech Wear】

items.summary_en: Cool tech wear all in achromatic tones. Layering a crop top and cargo pants under a long coat, a rugged street style accented with side pouches.

items.title: キプキプヘイロー/kipkip halo まめまめヘイロー/mamemame halo 【キプフェル、まめひなた専用】
items.title_en: Kipkip Halo / Mamemame Halo [Exclusive to Kipfel and Mamehinata]
items.title_display: キプキプヘイロー/kipkip halo まめまめヘイロー/mamemame halo 【キプフェル、まめひなた専用】
items.title_en_display: Kipkip Halo / Mamemame Halo [Exclusive to Kipfel and Mamehinata]
items.summary: アバターの愛称が肉球と一緒に頭上をくるくる巡る、専用サイズのヘイローパーティクル。アバター直下に置くだけで位置が合い、支援版には腕を回るリングも同梱。
items.summary_en: Halo particles sized for their dedicated avatars, where the avatar's nickname circles overhead alongside paw pads. Placement under the avatar aligns it automatically, and the support version adds a ring that orbits your arm.

items.title: FG-9 ”Voyager”🚀
items.title_display: FG-9 ”Voyager”
items.summary: 装甲パネルとバックパックを備えた本格的な宇宙服。ヘルメットを外せば素顔も見せられ、白とオレンジの2色を収録。
items.summary_en: A full-fledged spacesuit with armor panels and a backpack. Removing the helmet reveals the face, and both white and orange colorways are included.

items.title: [VRChat] Änglavingar Choker (対応: 4アバター)【3Dモデル】
items.title_display: [VRChat] Änglavingar Choker (対応: 4アバター)【3Dモデル】

items.summary_en: A choker threading a heart-shaped ring onto a leather band, with a winged cross hanging below. A single piece that places sweetness and unease at the throat at once.

items.title: モダンブロック時計 / Modern Blocks Clock
items.title_display: モダンブロック時計 / Modern Blocks Clock

items.summary_en: A modern wooden wall-mounted clock with hands moving in real time. Second-hand sound can be toggled ON/OFF, perfect for setting the mood in home worlds or photo sets.

items.title: 【VRChat】めちゃくえすと
items.title_display: 【VRChat】めちゃくえすと

items.summary_en: A head-mounted prop parodying a certain VR headset. The band adjusts via Bone control, and visibility toggles from the menu, a lightweight design perfect for joke shots and avatar play.

items.title: 【３D素材】かっこいいランタン（色は好みで変更してね）

items.summary_en: A 3D model of a decorative lantern adorned with deer antlers. Color-changeable and shining at photo shoots and world atmosphere-building as a free prop.

items.title: 【くうた-Kuuta 】くうたくんエルフ耳 Kuuta Ear Elf BlendShapekeys

items.title: もちふぃった～変換プロファイル / 胴長パグ
items.title_display: もちふぃった～変換プロファイル / 胴長パグ

items.summary_en: A Mochifitter conversion profile that fits outfits made for other avatars onto the Long-Bodied Pug. Distributed free with forward conversion only, it widens your dress-up options.

items.title: 森羅ちゃんポーズ2 (APL対応)
items.title_display: 森羅ちゃんポーズ2 (APL対応)

items.summary_en: A collection of 30 poses gathering standing figures and gestures that look good on camera. AvatarPoseLibrary compatible, it can be called up simply by placing the prefab under the avatar.
